limitations: Compiled production quote, recent-purchase, daily contribution and reputation logic
A local purchase followed by returns is protected; initial carried goods sold before a new local purchase have no prior purchase record
Growth-off/volume0 and growth-on/volume0; levels1/max; stock ratios .25/.5/1/2/4; normal/market day; quantities1/5/20/100; both orders
No time passage/restock/NPC traders/cash/capacity constraints/haggle success probability; one-unit actual-data witnesses are recorded separately
Positive finite cycles alone do not establish indefinitely repeatable arbitrage
Shared RegionData instances by ID; twelve-hour window is measured from most recent purchase in each aggregated record
